headline.text: L1 S2 metal detector failed test cards at 15:32 — *X-ray verified working*, MD repaired, 1 pallet WIP on hold awaiting final verification.

summary: One active hold from L1 S2 metal-detector failure. Two food-safety flags at L1: makeshift cardboard guard on S4 conveyor creates foreign-material risk, and L3 ML4 mixer-drive metal wear investigation closed clean. Cross-product WIP contamination at L2 FFS requires follow-up with L3.

holds.title: S2 WIP pallet on hold — metal detector failure
holds.summary: One pallet of WIP produced at 15:10 placed on hold after metal detector failed test-card verification at 15:32; MD repaired and re-verified with X-ray backup; pallet awaits final disposition through MD.
holds.status: On hold pending final MD verification before release.

food_safety.title: S4 cardboard & tape used as makeshift conveyor guard
food_safety.summary: Operators improvised cardboard and tape as guard on conveyor to prevent caramel drop; creates foreign-material risk if cardboard enters product zone; maintenance notified to fabricate proper metal guard.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance committed to installing proper guard, cardboard still in place as of window close.

food_safety.title: S2 metal detector failed test cards
food_safety.summary: Metal detector failed to reject test cards at 15:32; line paused immediately, maintenance adjusted equipment, MD re-verified passing cards three times, X-ray double-checked and confirmed working; one pallet WIP isolated from 15:10–15:30 window.
food_safety.status: Resolved — MD and X-ray verified working, hold pallet awaiting disposition.

food_safety.title: ML4 mixer drive metal wear investigation
food_safety.summary: Mixer drive not fully seated caused metal scraping at center piece; maintenance and QA investigated, confirmed no metal contaminated product, no damage to depositor; precautionary deep clean completed, ATP and allergen passed, micros sent to lab.
food_safety.status: Resolved — investigation closed, no product impact, ATP/allergen passed, micros pending lab.

quality.title: S2 flow-wrap best-before date doesn't match spec
quality.summary: Flow-wrap film best-before month doesn't match spec; Charity and Candon approved continuing production with current film until 1st shift change today when new BBD starts; flow-wrap itself does not print EXP date.
quality.status: Resolved — approved to run, new BBD starts at shift change.

quality.title: FFS wrong WIP on 21140 pallets — twice
quality.summary: Third shift found loose WIP from other products (truffle, Hershey caramel) on top of 21140 pallets on two separate occasions; cross-product contamination risk; L3 follow-up requested.
quality.status: Open — Alan Todd asked to follow up with L3 on WIP handling.

quality.title: 10 pallets inadequate film wrap
quality.summary: Ten finished pallets wrapped with insufficient film, cannot ship as-is; operators reminded of wrap standards, pallets flagged for re-wrap before release.
quality.status: Open — pallets identified, re-wrap in progress.

opportunities.text: Consider adding metal-detector test-card verification to hourly QA checklist on S2 jar line — today's failure at 15:32 was caught by scheduled check, but hourly frequency would tighten the window on any future failure.
Review foreign-material controls on S4 — the cardboard-and-tape guard improvised by operators suggests either missing equipment or unclear escalation path when guards are inadequate.
Standardize WIP staging and pallet-top protocols between L2 and L3 — twice tonight FFS received 21140 pallets with loose foreign WIP on top, cited as originating from L3.
